title: PasswordProfile
description: Contains the password profile associated with a user.

forceChangePasswordNextSignIn.description: Whether the user must change the password on the next sign-in.

forceChangePasswordNextSignInWithMfa.description: Whether the user must perform multi-factor authentication before being forced to change their password.

password.description: The password for the user. Must satisfy the tenant's password complexity requirements. Minimum of 8 characters.
